message.reasoning_content:

message.content:
To project onto the vector  
\[
v=\begin{pmatrix}1\\7\end{pmatrix},
\]
the projection matrix is given by
\[
P=\frac{vv^T}{v^Tv}.
\]

First compute:
\[
vv^T=\begin{pmatrix}1\\7\end{pmatrix}\begin{pmatrix}1&7\end{pmatrix}
=
\begin{pmatrix}
1 & 7\\
7 & 49
\end{pmatrix}.
\]

Next,
\[
v^Tv=\begin{pmatrix}1&7\end{pmatrix}\begin{pmatrix}1\\7\end{pmatrix}
=1^2+7^2=1+49=50.
\]

Thus
\[
P=\frac{1}{50}
\begin{pmatrix}
1 & 7\\
7 & 49
\end{pmatrix}.
\]

So the projection matrix is
\[
\begin{pmatrix}
\frac{1}{50} & \frac{7}{50}\\[4pt]
\frac{7}{50} & \frac{49}{50}
\end{pmatrix}.
\]

The answer is \(\begin{pmatrix}\frac{1}{50}&\frac{7}{50}\\[4pt]\frac{7}{50}&\frac{49}{50}\end{pmatrix}\).
